about: Runtime particle materials + white-card guard (Scripts/Combat/FxMaterials.cs). CombatVFX/BloodBurst materials are rebuilt on particleShader (tex * vertex colour * tint; additive = One/One, alpha = premultiplied One/OneMinusSrcAlpha) because HDRP/Unlit ignores Shuriken vertex colour and alpha. The guard logs renderers whose material is null or whose shader does not start with an okPrefixes entry, and swaps a null/non-HDRP ParticleSystemRenderer material for an invisible one (keepShaders are exempt from the swap, e.g. the ClashFx Sprites/Default particles).
